note: Lean states the reorganization as pointwise identities of field expressions (Harvest.Route.decomposition, Solstice.puncture_eq) and proves integrability for whole expressions (Deliver.each_weight). The caveat that individual unsubtracted summands need not be integrable has no Lean counterpart, as it asserts nothing to prove.

lemma decomposition (f : Menu k) (w z x) : r.windings M D T f w z x=
    ∑ b∈(r.components M T w).slate i.val (f i.val), r.select M T D i (d:=d) (show Way d i.val from b) f w (System.sliceAt P i.val (f i.val).slice (r.net i b w z)) x := by
   unfold windings scoreAt; rw [System.renewal P (r.length w) (r.components M T w) f Q i h,map_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
   unfold select scoreAt net; rw [r.treated,r.core_mask]; rfl

proof_context.conclusion: windings equals the sum over arms b of the selected arm expressions, pointwise, as an identity of scored field expressions with test operators.

lemma puncture_eq (D : Reader E W X k Z.sector.derivatives)(h : 1 < g.card)(w : W)(p : SmoothTests E)(hh : Loose P g p) : outsideCost r M T D w p=r.windings M D T (festive k) w p := by
   funext x; let Y:= r.components M T w; have hg:g.Nonempty:= Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
   unfold windings scoreAt outsideCost outsideC; rw [tag_alone hg, ← full_loose _ (r.length w) h p hh]; simp_rw [festive,System.all_votes]

proof_context.conclusion: The punctured outside cost equals the windings expression pointwise (funext), with no integrability assumption.

lemma each_weight (n : ℕ) (hw : r.stage w ⊆ strip (normalOn P g) (M.clearance n)) : Integrable (r.windings M (rootCoeff r M n) X f w p):= by
    let x(_:Unit):=w; let q:=pullBank r x; let D:=coefficient_loan q hg M n (fun _=> hw) H
    have he : q.windings M (rootCoeff q M n) (X ∘ x) f () p=r.windings M (rootCoeff r M n) X f w p:= rfl; rw [← he]; exact readable (r:=q) (T:= X∘x) f () p D (given_drops X x hT) (show q.Authority M d from hm) H hp

proof_context.conclusion: Integrability is proved for windings expressions on the clearance strip as wholes.
